Splitting the fraction into separate terms and then simplifying the fractions in the individual terms, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{6a-7b+10}{2} & = \\ \frac{6a}{2}-\frac{7b}{2}+\frac{10}{2} & = \\ \frac{6}{2}\cdot a-\frac{7b}{2}+\frac{10}{2} & = \\ 3a-\frac{7b}{2}+5 & .\end{aligned}
$$
